packaging.scope: Nine predetermined simulation profiles and one maximum-geometry static compile; no simulation of128x128

counter_scope.main: Frames/pixels/dense outputs/extensions/tail checks/held/source stalls count only900 main fixtures; excludes reset/probe/fresh work.
counter_scope.input_texture_coverage: Run/nonzero-bin/constant coverage describes all input images including35 rejected frames; every emitted error count/run total is zero.
counter_scope.extra_resets: 89 immediate cancellations and89 complete fresh images, outside main counters.

extra_reset_fresh_checks.held_target: OUT_HOLD with observed held output plus blocked pending next-frame source; tested good and error records
extra_reset_fresh_checks.additional: Partial error capture drain when N>1; no active edge between observed full target and reset_now

packaging.development_note: Initial compile stopped because bins was a reserved SystemVerilog coverage keyword. Renamed memory hist_mem; predetermined matrix, arithmetic/schedule and fixtures unchanged. Failed commands and prior source hashes retained separately. Current33 records allPASS; no timeout or fixture reduction.
self_audit: Every geometric direction decomposes the full grid into disjoint lines; zero and singleton lines are counted, preserving weighted sum N.
Each extension increments its new-length bin then decrements a distinct old-length bin. A current provisional run guarantees nonzero old count; all temporary counts<=N.
Old D[x] is captured before current-row write, excluded atx0; top-left old cache reused only on the next column. A[x+1] stays ahead of current-row writes; all previous-row history ignored aty0.
Four histogram banks operate in parallel with synchronous read/write phases; no collision mode or forwarding dependency.
All padded histogram locations cleared before frame acceptance; line history first-row gating and complete fresh nonconstant frames check reset isolation.
Input first tag owns fixed-N capture even on malformed markers; errors known before output and gate every dense count/run total tozero.
Finite matrix fixed before first tool run. Maximum square compile only; no hidden long numerical run, timeout retry, physical flow or expanded regression.
